descriptionChirho: The heavenly heights where God dwells; 'on high' or 'from on high' referring to the celestial/divine sphere above the earth.
A literal high place, summit, or elevated terrain; the height or top of a mountain, hill, or other geographical feature.
Metaphorical height as arrogance or self-exaltation; loftiness in the sense of prideful defiance.
Persons or beings of high rank or exalted position; those who hold elevated authority or dignity.
